title: "Herring_model"

```{r}
#| label: Herring Model
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# All functions are called with package::function() to avoid conflicts between different packages containing identical functions names.
# All packages used in the code is in the references at the end. 
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Parameters 
year_min <- 1950L      # Start year
year_max <- 2019L      # End year
doy_wrap_start <- 300  # Start of seasonal day of year (DOY)

# Function for wrapping DOY across the year boundary
wrap_doy <- function(doy, wrap_start = 300, days_in_year = 365) {
  # Converts DOY >= 300 to negative values 
  dplyr::if_else(doy >= wrap_start, doy - days_in_year, doy)
}

# Input data from targets pipeline
# See the other GitHub URL for access to the input data (Awaiting approval for publication as of 1. June 2026)
ana <- targets::tar_read(herring_model_df)

# Selects and formats variables used in the model
dat <- ana |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    year = as.integer(.data$year),          
    doy = as.numeric(.data$doy),
    lat = as.numeric(.data$lat),
    spawn = as.integer(.data$maturity_bin),
    gear = .data$gear,
    age = as.numeric(.data$age),
    length = as.numeric(.data$length),
    ssb_tonnes = as.numeric(.data$ssb_tonnes),
    nao_index = as.numeric(.data$nao_index)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$year >= year_min,
    .data$year <= year_max,
    # Keeps only data withing the winter season (DOY >= 300 or DOY <= 120)
    .data$doy >= doy_wrap_start | .data$doy <= 120,
    # Binary response
    .data$spawn %in% c(0L, 1L)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Creates continous seasonal structure
    doy_season = wrap_doy(.data$doy, wrap_start = doy_wrap_start),
    year_f = factor(.data$year),
    gear_f = factor(.data$gear),
    log_ssb = log10(.data$ssb_tonnes),
    # Z-scaled for standardisation
    log_ssb_z = as.numeric(scale(.data$log_ssb)),
    nao_z = as.numeric(scale(.data$nao_index))
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stats::complete.cases(
      # Removes observiations with missing model variables 
      .data$spawn,
      .data$doy_season,
      .data$lat,
      .data$age,
      .data$length,
      .data$year_f,
      .data$gear_f,
      .data$log_ssb_z,
      .data$nao_z
    )
  )

# Herring model
Herring_mod <- mgcv::bam(
  spawn ~ doy_season +
    s(lat, k = 5) +
    te(age, length, k = c(4, 4)) +
    s(year_f, bs = "re") +
    s(log_ssb_z, k = 3) +
    nao_z +
    gear_f,
  family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = dat,
  method = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)
```
